meta.notes: Edit this file to update BOTH the dashboard blockers table and the daily reminder emails on the next scheduled run. Any blocker whose status contains CLOSED/COMPLETED/RESOLVED/DONE is filtered out automatically.

blockers.title: Claude & AWS Server allotment for 22 of 41 IPs
blockers.description: 19/41 done — compute allotted for controllers listed earlier. 22 IPs remain: H.265, AMBA AXI, PCIe Gen6 Sw, CXL, UALink 2.0, Ultra Ethernet, HBM4, 5 RISC-V cores (XR-V1…V5), and 10 new Space IPs (V2SP, V3SP, ECC/EDAC, Memory Scrubber, Fault-Management, Lockstep/TMR, SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, NoC-FT, Root of Trust — added Sep-26, all UNASSIGNED). Target closure will slip well past 10-Sep without accelerated staffing.

blockers.title: SCL partnership for Space-IP rad-hard prototypes
blockers.description: Sign up with SCL (Semi-Conductor Laboratory) for future Space IPs — rad-hardened prototypes on 180nm process; unlocks ISRO / DRDO / BEL pipeline

blockers.title: DLI funding for PCIe Gen6 Switch tapeout
blockers.description: Discuss with C-DAC / IESA for DLI (Design Linked Incentive) funding — target: PCIe Gen6 Switch fabric tapeout ($400K ASP · $4.91M FY30 revenue)

blockers.title: 3 new AI/Datacenter IPs — team assignment & compute
blockers.description: Three newly added AI/Datacenter & memory IPs — UALink 2.0 (chiplet fabric, competes with UCIe/NVLink), Ultra Ethernet (AI-cluster RDMA, competes with InfiniBand), HBM4 Controller (next-gen 3D-stacked memory) — all Mar-27 GA. RTL & DV owners UNASSIGNED, Claude + AWS NOT ALLOTTED. Every week unstaffed pushes Mar-27 gate to Jun-27 and puts ~$2.4M FY30 revenue at risk.

blockers.title: RISC-V CPU family (5 cores XR-V1…V5) — new product line, entire team to build
blockers.description: Five new RISC-V cores added to portfolio — XR-V1 (RV32 tiny, IoT/wearables), XR-V2 (RV32 perf MCU, automotive/robotics), XR-V3 (RV64 efficient AP, edge-AI/drones), XR-V4 (RV64 OoO, Linux/networking/cockpit), XR-V5 (RV64 Vector, AI accelerators/HPC). RTL/DV UNASSIGNED across all 5, no compute. Requires a net-new CPU architecture team (5-8 engineers) — hiring plan due by 20-Sep. Represents $7.85M FY30 (22% of the 41-IP model); slippage puts the uplift to $36.20M at risk.

blockers.title: Space IP portfolio (10 IPs) — rad-hard team + SCL/ISRO qualification path
blockers.description: Ten new Space IPs — V2SP (16-bit RISC-V space processor), V3SP (32-bit RISC-V space processor), ECC/EDAC library, Memory Scrubber, Fault-Management Controller, Lockstep/TMR library, SpaceWire (controller/router), SpaceFibre (controller), NoC-FT (fault-tolerant NoC), Root of Trust. RTL/DV UNASSIGNED across all 10. Requires a dedicated rad-hard/space-IP team (4-6 engineers) with fault-tolerance experience, plus SCL 180nm tape-out slot (couples with B2). Represents $4M FY30 uplift (from $32.20M → $36.20M) and opens the ISRO/DRDO/BEL/Ananth Technologies pipeline. Hiring plan + SCL MoU due by 15-Oct.
